transcripts.transcript: A reliable service does not have to be the fastest on every occasion, but people need to know what to expect. Let me put that another way: consistency matters because users plan around it. Again, the central issue is whether the service behaves as promised often enough for people to depend on it.
transcripts.target_signal: 从重复表达中提炼同一重点
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: In the first study, clear examples helped participants complete unfamiliar forms with fewer omissions. A second study found the same pattern in a different group. The researchers repeated that the consistent finding concerned missing information, not faster completion or higher satisfaction, which were not measured in both studies.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分反复验证的发现与新增解释
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: If we look only at the distance to an ambitious goal, progress can be easy to overlook. We keep asking how far remains, instead of noticing how far we have come. I am not arguing against goals; I am asking us to measure gains as well as gaps when judging the value of our effort.
transcripts.target_signal: 理解反复对照的论证目的
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: A booking page may be technically available but impossible to use on a small screen. A help desk may be open only when students are in class. A guide may contain the answer but use unfamiliar terms. These examples make the same point: providing a service is not the same as making it genuinely accessible.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别被多个例子共同强化的主题
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: We can compare prices, brands, and optional features for hours. But I want to return to the same question: what problem must the equipment solve? Unless we answer that, a cheaper purchase may still be a waste. The priority, as I have stressed throughout, is fitness for the actual task.
transcripts.target_signal: 从多次强调中辨认优先事项
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The tool can offer useful suggestions, provided that students examine them critically. I repeat that condition because accepting every suggestion automatically would defeat the purpose. Used with careful judgement, the tool may support learning; used as a substitute for judgement, it may simply hide misunderstandings.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分反复出现的条件与无条件承诺
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Across the three surveys, people who felt their activities were meaningful tended to report greater satisfaction. I want to stress that pattern again, while also reminding you that the surveys alone cannot establish which factor caused the other.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别贯穿多次研究的重复结论
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Let me repeat the central finding: the association appeared in each of the age groups we studied. That does not mean we tested every population. The sample came from one region, and further work is needed before drawing wider conclusions.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析重复重点的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The first survey found an association, and the second found a similar pattern in another group. The third used a different measure and reached a more cautious conclusion. Taken together, they suggest a relationship worth investigating, rather than a question that is fully settled.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析重复重点的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: I have returned to the same finding several times because it helps connect the examples. But repetition itself is not extra evidence. What matters is whether the studies were well designed and whether other researchers can test the result independently.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析重复重点的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: I want to return to the distinction that has guided this talk. The number of activities in a day tells us less than the quality of our involvement in them. The same busy schedule can feel very different depending on why we chose those activities.
transcripts.target_signal: 理解呼应全文的核心对照
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Overall, the association was observed in several groups, but its strength varied with the setting and the way it was measured. That is the conclusion I want to leave with you: a recurring pattern can be useful without being identical everywhere.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析重复重点的含义与适用条件
